gdp_yoy.source: MOSPI Press Note on GDP Estimates for Q1 (Apr–Jun) 2026-27, released Aug 31, 2026 (base year 2022-23): real GDP +7.8% YoY vs 6.9% in Q1 FY26. Q4 FY26 revised up to 8.6% in the same release, so growth slowed sequentially. Next release (Q2) due Nov 30, 2026. Retrieved via search (mospi.gov.in not reachable from routine network).

cpi.source: MOSPI CPI Press Release for October 2026 (provisional, base year 2024), released Nov 12, 2026: headline 6.09% YoY (Sep: 5.54%), food 8.94%, rural 6.63%, urban 5.41%. Breaches RBI 6% upper tolerance. Reported by DD News (ddnews.gov.in), Down To Earth, DSIJ.

gsec10y.source: Benchmark 6.94% 2036 G-Sec closed at 7.3079% on Nov 13, 2026 (vs 7.2467% prior session), per market report; Trading Economics 7.31%. One month ago: 7.30% (Oct 9 close) and ~7.40% 3-year high (Oct 13). Net roughly flat over the month after a 22 bp fall and 12 bp rebound in the last two weeks.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC (Oct 5–7, 2026) unanimously HIKED repo by 25 bps to 5.50% and shifted stance from neutral to 'calibrated tightening' (4–2); SDF 5.25%, MSF 5.75%. Next MPC Dec 2–4, 2026. Policy direction is now tightening, not easing.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution / press release, Oct 7, 2026 (via RBI Bulletin, Drishti IAS, PSU Connect, Moneylife coverage).

gov_capex.note: Centre's capex in Apr–Sep 2026 (H1 FY27) was ~₹6.55 lakh crore, ~54% of the ₹12.22 lakh crore FY27 BE (ahead of pro-rata pace); CPSE capex ~₹4.30 lakh crore in H1 (+12% YoY). Monthly momentum softened (Aug/Sep YoY declines) and Jefferies expects non-defence capex to slow in H2, but the capex push remains on track.
gov_capex.source: CGA Union Government Accounts Apr–Sep 2026 (released end-Oct 2026) via secondary coverage (Angel One, Oquilia, Asianet Newsable); Jefferies note via NewKerala (Oct 7, 2026).

china_plus_one.note: Govt continues to court global manufacturers relocating supply chains: Commerce Minister Goyal urged US manufacturers to expand in India at a NAM roundtable (~Sep 30, 2026) and Japanese firms to build full value chains in India (Aug 2026). Caveat: NITI Aayog report says India's China+1 capture has been 'limited' vs Vietnam/Thailand; thesis active but mixed.
china_plus_one.source: Outlook India — 'Piyush Goyal Urges US Manufacturers To Expand In India At NAM Roundtable' (~Sep 30, 2026); Tribune India (Aug 29, 2026); India Sea Trade News on NITI Aayog report (Sep–Nov 2026).

rural_recovery.note: Deficient 2026 monsoon has dried soil moisture: Agri Ministry rabi sowing at 108.66 lakh ha as of Nov 6, 2026, down 17.2% YoY (gram −21.6%); rural CPI at 6.63% (above urban 5.41%) with food inflation 8.94% squeezing rural real incomes.
rural_recovery.source: Ministry of Agriculture weekly rabi sowing progress (as of Nov 6, 2026) via Investment Guru India / Lapaas Voice; Business Today (Nov 3, 2026); MOSPI October 2026 CPI (Nov 12, 2026).

put_call_ratio.source: Nifty 50 open-interest PCR for the Nov 9, 2026 weekly expiry = 1.35 as of 3:35 PM IST on Nov 5, 2026 (Sahi PCR tracker, NSE option-chain derived). NSE option-chain itself not reachable from routine network. Note: 5paisa reported intraday PCR 1.59 on Nov 3; near-ATM-only PCR was 0.74 — use with caution.
